verdict.rationale: Whether a coding agent's source is available under an open license is a fair question for this kind of product, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack shows Jules's source being published or licensed openly. The docs describe a hosted service with a web app and an API key-gated API, and none of them mention an open-source repository or license.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
